coverage_limits: I read all 24 thirds, but had no crop or zoom tool, so I could not enlarge any image. s126, s128 and s130 (Et chil, Taalat zo, Even chug) differ from the dossier in many substantive places, and the current readings look like misreadings rather than the printed text. I give consonantal corrections where they are legible. Several words and many vowels on those pages cannot be read at this resolution and are listed as unresolved. These pages should not be accepted until an enlarged image is checked. The shemo_mefoarim citation that points to s136 is outside this scope and was not reviewed. Human decisions checked: the s132 German notes (גלייך, דאַ:, מְפָאֲרִים with hataf-patah under the alef and no meteg), the Metz note and the Kalir attribution. I found no contrary evidence for any of them. The source_typo_corrections list is empty, so none of the findings above is an already-recorded sic.
